purpose: Supervised right-arm shoulder continuation and independent two-sided probes of all seven joints; commissioning evidence, not an executable trajectory or accepted calibration.
commandTiming: App cmd_position_input log times, associated by observed UI command order. The log payload is private. These are not exact motor-dispatch or acquisition timestamps.
telemetryTiming: Mac gateway-queue receive timestamps; not synchronized robot acquisition times.
csvTargetCaveat: Manual Torso SDK commands do not update gateway target_rad/error_rad. Use the separately observed UI command vectors.
calibrationLimitations: Camera-to-robot extrinsics are null; URDF camera mounts are operator estimates.
Main and belly images show the distal arm; shoulder and upper arm are cropped.
Recorded frames lack capture epoch and stream-generation identity; receipt pairing is diagnostic only.
No independently measured camera joint angles, uncertainty or held-out validation pose.
J5 early returns exceed the existing 0.5-degree stationary encoder-spread criterion.

The original late J6/J7 final-return marks lack matching exported telemetry. Additional retrospectively selected saved return frames have receipt-time pairs; neither establishes acquisition synchronization.
Image patch translations do not establish model-axis signs, absolute offsets or collision clearance.

Operator confirmed entire right arm clear and watching for J3/J2/J1 +/-0.02 about the inspection baseline, four seconds per leg, returning between excursions.

displayFreshnessInvestigation.firstObservation: After J3 +0.02: table rows J4-J7 marked stale while both summaries said all joint replies current. No return or shoulder command sent until current observations and a passive CAN check.
displayFreshnessInvestigation.secondObservation: After the J3 negative return: both summaries showed local receipt ages 0.25/0.26 s and all rows stale. Further commands paused until a fresh zero-position observation.
displayFreshnessInvestigation.csvCANReplyAgeEvidence: In the first event export, right-joint receive ages after 06:43:30Z were below 7 ms, with no age over 250 ms. The later export had maximum right CAN age 5.982204 ms, controller age 12.657496 ms, and Mac packet-receipt gap 173 ms.
displayFreshnessInvestigation.resolution: Fresh UI observations returned without a restart or cable action. Completed the next planned leg; did not repeat the positive command.
displayFreshnessInvestigation.inference: Display/main-thread timing is implicated; the exact cause of the transient mixed table/summary state was not instrumented or proven.
